name: asyncapi-mqtt-proto-gen
description: AsyncAPI Generator template that turns an inline-proto MQTT AsyncAPI spec into a typed client project (messageBus.<channel>.publish/subscribe/address). Run with: asyncapi generate fromTemplate <spec> https://github.com/melalex/asyncapi-mqtt-proto-gen -p lang=cpp -p projectName=<name>

lang.description: Target language for the generated client. Supported values: cpp, python, js, ts, webgui.

projectName.description: Name used for the generated project (CMake project name / Python package name / npm package name, include directory, namespace). Defaults to a slug of info.title.

scripts.generate:example: asyncapi generate fromTemplate test/fixtures/fleet-sample.yaml . -p lang=cpp -p projectName=demo_bus -o /tmp/asyncapi-mqtt-proto-gen-example --force-write
scripts.generate:example:python: asyncapi generate fromTemplate test/fixtures/fleet-sample.yaml . -p lang=python -p projectName=demo_bus -o /tmp/asyncapi-mqtt-proto-gen-example-py --force-write
scripts.generate:example:js: asyncapi generate fromTemplate test/fixtures/fleet-sample.yaml . -p lang=js -p projectName=demo_bus -o /tmp/asyncapi-mqtt-proto-gen-example-js --force-write
scripts.generate:example:ts: asyncapi generate fromTemplate test/fixtures/fleet-sample.yaml . -p lang=ts -p projectName=demo_bus -o /tmp/asyncapi-mqtt-proto-gen-example-ts --force-write
scripts.generate:example:webgui: asyncapi generate fromTemplate test/fixtures/fleet-sample.yaml . -p lang=webgui -p projectName=demo_bus -o /tmp/asyncapi-mqtt-proto-gen-example-webgui --force-write
